llm.summary: The skill is mostly coherent for managing Tremendous through OOMOL, but its fallback setup tells an agent to run an unverified remote installer script and it handles sensitive reward/account data through a third-party connector.

dimensions.detail: The skill discloses that OOMOL injects credentials server-side and routes Tremendous connector operations, but users should understand that payloads and returned reward/order data pass through OOMOL.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: First-time setup includes curl-to-bash and PowerShell invoke-expression installer commands from a mutable remote URL, which could execute code not present in the reviewed artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger text is broad for any Tremendous request, but the operational instructions are limited to the tremendous connector and schema-driven actions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No local persistence, backdoor, or privilege escalation is shipped in the artifact; account login and Tremendous connection setup are one-time integration steps, while the remote installer remains the main privilege concern.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The declared purpose, allowed oo CLI connector use, and listed Tremendous actions fit together; write-capable reward order operations are disclosed and require user confirmation.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing. Use it only if you trust OOMOL with your Tremendous connector credentials and reward/order data, confirm all order-creation payloads carefully, and avoid running the remote installer pipeline unless you have independently verified the installer source and integrity.
llm.findings:
[SC2] unexpected: Installing the oo CLI supports the skill, but immediate execution of an unverified remote installer is not a proportionate or reviewable setup mechanism.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad Tremendous trigger is overinclusive, but it still points to the declared Tremendous integration rather than unrelated behavior.
[SDI-4] expected: The get_order write label appears internally inconsistent and likely causes extra confirmation rather than silently reducing safety.
[T03] unexpected: The artifact contains remote installer execution instructions whose payload is outside the reviewed package.
[other] expected: Routing Tremendous operations through OOMOL is central to this connector skill and is disclosed, though it expands the data and credential trust boundary.
